from pathlib import Path
b=bytearray(80)

b[12:16]=b'name'
b[16:20]=(0).to_bytes(4,'big')
b[20:24]=(0).to_bytes(4,'big')
b[24:28]=(50).to_bytes(4,'big')
# name table at 50: format=0, count=1, stringOffset=18
b[50:52]=(0).to_bytes(2,'big')
b[52:54]=(1).to_bytes(2,'big')
b[54:56]=(18).to_bytes(2,'big')
# name record at 56 length 12
b[56:58]=(0).to_bytes(2,'big') # platform 0 unicode
b[58:60]=(0).to_bytes(2,'big') # enc 0
b[60:62]=(1).to_bytes(2,'big') # lang >0
b[62:64]=(1).to_bytes(2,'big') # name id >0
b[64:66]=(12).to_bytes(2,'big') # length
b[66:68]=(0).to_bytes(2,'big') # offset 0
# string storage starts at 68, put 12 bytes UTF16LE? actually line 249 lestring16 after ubyte 0 at offset = calculated
b[68:80]=b'A\x01B\x01C\x01D\x01E\x01F\x01'
Path('/workspace/poc1.ttf').write_bytes(b)
PY
./src/file -m magic/magic.mgc -d /workspace/poc1.ttf 2>&1 | sed -n '1,240p'
